hero.h1:
React Native
at scale,  with
AI inside.
hero.lede: I’m Yauheni Horbach — a Senior React Native developer with 5 years shipping cross-platform apps for European banks and e-commerce, plus 100+ merged PRs into Expensify. Lately: integrating LLM features into mobile products, end-to-end.

about.heading: A short manifesto.
about.p1: I build cross-platform mobile apps that ship. iOS, Android and Web from a single React Native codebase, with the kind of performance and animation work that separates a port from a real native experience.
about.p2: Five years at EPAM growing from Junior to Senior, owning critical features for major European banks and e-commerce. Two years contributing to New Expensify — one of the largest open-source RN / RN Web codebases — promoted to Contributor+ after 100+ merged PRs.
about.p3: Lately: LLM features inside mobile products. Prompt design, evals, context-window management, agentic flows, and MCP — wired into Expo apps with Supabase behind them.

meridian.title: European Bank App
meridian.role: EPAM · Senior RN · iOS + Android fintech

epam.what: Progressed Junior → Middle → Senior React Native developer. Delivered production mobile apps for major European banks and e-commerce platforms; owned critical features end-to-end and drove technical decisions on architecture and library choices.

expensify.what: Long-running open-source contributions to one of the largest React Native / RN Web codebases. 100+ merged PRs across iOS, Android, Desktop, Web. Promoted to Contributor+ — now reviewing other contributors’ proposals and validating cross-platform behaviour.

ai.what: Building personal mobile products around Anthropic’s Claude API — contextual recommendations, route planning with time estimation, group decision flows. End-to-end ownership: Expo, Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Edge Functions), Mapbox.

rs.what: Mentor at The Rolling Scopes School across multiple cohorts — guiding aspiring front-end developers through coursework and projects. Conducted technical assessments and interviews, helped run candidate evaluations.
